offlineBody: Payment changes can’t be made while offline. Refunds and removing a recorded payment both have to reach the payment provider, so they can’t be saved on this device and sent later.
offlineUnchanged: Order #{orderId} is unchanged. Reconnect and open this again.
removeBody: This removes the {amount} recorded against order #{orderId}. The order stays where it is; only the payment record is removed.
paidByCardBody: Order #{orderId} was paid by card, so there is no payment record to remove here — the money is already on the customer’s card.
alreadyRefunded: {refunded} of {charged} has already been refunded, so there is nothing left to refund on this order.
refundSummary: {charged} was paid by card{hasRefunded, select, yes {, {refunded} already refunded} other {}}. {refundable} can be refunded.
footer: This sends the money back to the customer’s card. It cannot be undone from here.
